zh: 回飞机
en: Back to the ship

zh: 出门，回飞机
en: Head out, back to the ship

zh: 回树屋
en: Back to the treehouse

zh: 跟鹿上坡地
en: Follow the deer up the slope

zh: 跟上弥洛
en: Catch up with Milo

zh: 送水泵
en: Deliver the water pump

zh: 修好推进器
en: Fix the thruster

zh: 找阀门
en: Find a valve

zh: 找弹簧
en: Find a spring

zh: 找松脂
en: Find sap

zh: 找弹簧、阀门
en: Find a spring and a valve

zh: 找松脂、阀门
en: Find sap and a valve

zh: 找松脂、弹簧
en: Find sap and a spring

zh: 找松脂、弹簧、阀门
en: Find sap, a spring, a valve

zh: 找会修的人
en: Find someone who can fix it

zh: 跟着鹿
en: Follow the deer

zh: 试着启动飞机
en: Try starting the ship

zh: 找燃料
en: Find fuel

zh: ……该走了。
en: ...Time to go.

zh: 飞机修好了。
en: The ship's fixed.

zh: 门在左边。
en: The door's on the left.

zh: ……鹿还在外面吧。
en: ...The deer's probably still outside.

zh: ……弥洛还在树屋里。
en: ...Milo's still in the treehouse.

zh: 回去看看吧。
en: I should go back.

zh: 鹿在坡上等我。
en: The deer's waiting on the slope.

zh: ……坡上有什么？
en: ...What's up on the slope?

zh: 她们往商店那边去了。
en: They went toward the shop.

zh: ……跟上去吧。
en: ...Better catch up.

zh: 三样都齐了。
en: That's all three.

zh: ……回树屋。
en: ...Back to the treehouse.

zh: 罐子还空着。
en: The jar's still empty.

zh: 松脂……哪棵树在流松脂？
en: Sap... which tree is leaking sap?

zh: 门口那只鹿，也许知道。
en: The deer by the door might know.

zh: 还差一根弹簧。
en: Still need a spring.

zh: 空屋的窗台上，好像有个闹钟。
en: I think there's a clock on the empty house's windowsill.

zh: 空地上那个信号箱……
en: That signal box in the clearing...

zh: 阀门也许还在上面。
en: Maybe the valve's still on it.

zh: 木板也许能搭在塌陷口上。
en: A plank might reach across the sinkhole.

zh: ……回旧路去试试。
en: ...Let's try the old road.

zh: 阀门……塌陷口那边过不去。
en: The valve... but I can't get past the sinkhole.

zh: 得找块木板。
en: I need a plank.

zh: 商店里的货架好像塌了。
en: The shelves in the shop looked collapsed.

zh: 敲树的声音……从哪边来？
en: That knocking... which way is it coming from?

zh: ……水声最响的地方别去。
en: ...Stay away from where the water's loudest.

zh: 树枝上好像挂着什么。
en: Something's hanging from that branch.

zh: 底下那两根树枝，先拖开。
en: Drag those two branches out first.

zh: ……鹿在等我。
en: ...The deer's waiting.

zh: ……那只鹿还在前面等我。
en: ...The deer's still waiting up ahead.

zh: 前面好像被什么挡住了。
en: Something's blocking the way ahead.

zh: 鹿走得好慢……在等我？
en: The deer's going so slowly... waiting for me?

zh: 往前走吧。
en: Keep going.

zh: 旧路，在右边。
en: The old road's to the right.

zh: 燃料够了。
en: That's enough fuel.

zh: ……回飞机试试。
en: ...Let's try the ship.

zh: 燃料还不够。
en: Not enough fuel yet.

zh: 附近应该还有能烧的东西。
en: There should be more to burn around here.

zh: 左边好像有什么在反光。
en: Something's glinting off to the left.

zh: 飞机
en: Ship

zh: 树冠缺口
en: Gap in the trees

zh: 行李
en: Luggage

zh: 发光的木头
en: Glowing Wood

zh: 金属碎片
en: Metal Scrap

zh: 树脂
en: Resin

zh: 干枝
en: Dry Branch

zh: 鹿
en: Deer

zh: 小吃棚
en: Snack stall

zh: 小屋
en: Hut

zh: 倒木
en: Fallen Log

zh: 拖开树枝
en: Drag branch

zh: 鹿？
en: Deer?

zh: 蹄印
en: Hoofprints

zh: 树枝
en: Branch

zh: 布条
en: Cloth strip

zh: 去树屋
en: To the treehouse

zh: 水声
en: Rushing water

zh: 塌陷口
en: Sinkhole

zh: 岩石
en: Rock

zh: 信号箱
en: Signal box

zh: 底座
en: Sign base

zh: 回旧路
en: Back to the old road

zh: 树屋
en: Treehouse

zh: 弥洛
en: Milo

zh: 门边的包裹
en: Parcel by the door

zh: 门槛
en: Doorstep

zh: 窗台上的闹钟
en: Clock on the sill

zh: 商店
en: Shop

zh: 橱窗
en: Shop window

zh: 半张合影
en: Half a photo

zh: 木板
en: Plank

zh: 老松树
en: Old pine

zh: 凹陷
en: Hollows

zh: 雾
en: Fog

zh: 门
en: Door

zh: 收音机
en: Radio

zh: 路标
en: Signpost

zh: 油灯
en: Oil Lamp

zh: 工具墙
en: Tool wall

zh: 旧外套
en: Old coat

zh: 杯子
en: Cups

zh: 新零件的包装
en: New part's wrapping

zh: 明信片
en: Postcard

zh: 小碟子
en: Little dish

zh: 炉子
en: Stove

zh: 留声机
en: Gramophone

zh: 盒子
en: Box

zh: 管道
en: Pipes

zh: 啊……糟糕。早知道就买保险了。
en: Ugh... great. Should've gotten insurance.

zh: 行，你先歇着，我还没打算让你报废呢
en: Fine, you rest. I'm not scrapping you yet.

zh: ……是你说的那个吗？
en: ...Is that the one you told me about?

zh: ……刚才撞上的，是这个？
en: ...Is this what I just hit?

zh: 等一下！
en: Wait!

zh: 偏偏这时候坏，你可真会挑。
en: Breaking down now, of all times. Great timing.

zh: 我一定要找到大象，因为
en: I have to find the elephant, because

zh: 如果有一天我们不联系了，你就去找云层里的大象，找到它，就能再次收到我的消息。
en: If we ever stop talking, go find the elephant in the clouds. Find it, and you'll hear from me again.

zh: 我问为什么，她说到时候就知道了。我问我们为什么会不联系，她笑了一下。
en: I asked why. She said I'd know when the time came. I asked why we'd ever stop talking. She just smiled.

zh: 那道缺口的弧，和画上一样。
en: The curve of that gap. Same as the drawing.

zh: ……也可能，只是我撞的。
en: ...Or maybe I just did that.

zh: 缺口还在。
en: The gap's still there.

zh: 下次来，也许就长好了。
en: Maybe it'll have grown back by next time.

zh: 再撑一趟吧，就一趟
en: Hang in there. Just one more trip.

zh: 推进器坏了
en: The thruster's broken

zh: 先跟鹿去找会修的。
en: Follow the deer to someone who can fix it.

zh: 好，行李全摔出来了，都不用我翻了
en: Great. The luggage unpacked itself

zh: 在家唱得好好的，怎么一出来就哑了
en: It played fine at home. Why go quiet now

zh: 又是这个站，这名字我闭着眼都能写了
en: This station again. I could write it with my eyes closed

zh: 后面写什么呢，每次都卡在这儿
en: What comes next... I always get stuck here

zh: 有这个了，你总该动一下了吧
en: With this, you'll have to move, right

zh: 启动所需：200
en: Needed to launch: 200

zh: 行，那就再找一点
en: Fine. A bit more, then

zh: 飞机上掉的碎片，烧了也算用回去了
en: It fell off the ship. Burning it is sort of giving it back

zh: 这树脂黏我一手，应该还挺好烧的
en: Resin all over my hands. Should burn nicely

zh: 干透了，正好拿去烧
en: Bone dry. Perfect for burning

zh: 够了，回飞机那边试试
en: That's enough. Let's try the ship

zh: 推进器损坏
en: Thruster damaged

zh: 你就不能一次说完吗？
en: Couldn't you just say it all at once?

zh: 你这飞机掉下来以前就坏了
en: Your ship was broken before it fell

zh: 你怎么知道？
en: How do you know?

zh: 咱听着就不对
en: It sounded wrong

zh: 你从咱头顶过去，那动静，比打雷还难听
en: You went right over me. Sounded worse than thunder

zh: 就是降落的时候偏了点
en: The landing was a little off, that's all

zh: 偏得挺远。
en: A long way off.

zh: 你知道哪里能修吗？
en: Know anywhere I can get it fixed?

zh: 我平时开得没这么差。
en: I'm not usually this bad a pilot.

zh: 刚才树林里的声音，你听见了吗？
en: Did you hear that sound in the woods?

zh: 这你问咱就对了。
en: You asked the right deer.

zh: 咱倒是信，你问问树信不信
en: I believe you. Ask the trees if they do

zh: 听见了，林子这么大，什么响动都有
en: I heard. Big forest. All kinds of noises

zh: 先把你这飞机修好吧，跟咱走，咱认识个会修的
en: Let's get your ship fixed first. Come on, I know someone who fixes things

zh: 帮我看看这张画，你认得上面这个吗？
en: Can you look at this drawing? Do you know what this is?

zh: 大象啊，旧路那边有
en: That's an elephant. There's one down the old road

zh: 等等，你也知道大象？
en: Wait, you know about elephants too?

zh: 旧路
en: Old road

zh: 附近有水吗？
en: Is there water around here?

zh: 找水啊？这你可问对了
en: Water? You asked the right deer

zh: 前头往左，有条小溪，水甜。
en: Up ahead on the left. There's a creek. Sweet water.

zh: 旧路那头以前还有老大的脚印呢
en: There used to be huge footprints down the old road

zh: 脚印？
en: Footprints?

zh: 旧路以前有很大的脚印。
en: There used to be huge footprints on the old road.

zh: 你见的那头大象，长什么样？
en: The elephant you saw. What did it look like?

zh: 鼻子很长。
en: Long nose.

zh: 左边的耳朵会动。
en: Its left ear moves.

zh: 大象从树边过去的时候，树枝都跟着晃
en: When it walks past the trees, the branches all sway

zh: 这些你都亲眼见过？
en: You saw all that yourself?

zh: 咱见过
en: I did

zh: 鹿亲眼见过大象。
en: The deer saw the elephant with its own eyes.

zh: 鼻子很长，左边的耳朵会动，走过去的时候树枝都在晃。
en: Long nose. Left ear moves. The branches sway when it walks past.

zh: 这儿以前卖吃的。
en: They used to sell food here.

zh: 一下雨，大家就往这棚子底下挤
en: When it rained, everyone squeezed in under here

zh: 咱小时候也往里钻，角老勾着人家的布
en: I squeezed in too when I was little. My antlers kept snagging the canvas

zh: 卖什么？
en: Selling what?

zh: 卖什么来着……咱还真忘了
en: What was it... I really forget

zh: 反正好吃，咱吃过的，这个可不骗你
en: It was good, though. I ate it. That part I'm not making up

zh: 说不定大象以前也从这儿走过呢
en: Maybe the elephant walked by here once too

zh: 什么时候？
en: When?

zh: 页角：一只顶着棚布的鹿。
en: In the corner of the page: a deer with an awning on its head.

zh: 还没画好
en: Not done yet

zh: 给那只鹿添了一对过大的角。
en: Gave the deer a pair of oversized antlers.

zh: 棚子倒还撑得住
en: The stall's still standing, at least

zh: 我们那儿的车站，下雨的时候也这么挤
en: Our station back home got this crowded in the rain too

zh: 我都躲到最里头了，还是能淋一身
en: I'd stand all the way at the back and still get soaked

zh: 这东西放在棚子里也用不上，先带着吧
en: No use for this at the stall. I'll hang on to it

zh: 前头那棵歪树，打雷劈过。
en: That crooked tree up ahead got hit by lightning.

zh: 咱那天还在那棵树底下躲雨呢
en: I was hiding under it from the rain that day

zh: 大象也在前面？
en: Is the elephant up ahead too?

zh: 往前找找吧，兴许就碰上了
en: Keep looking. Maybe we'll run into it

zh: 这么小的屋子，住着倒省事
en: A house this small must be easy to keep

zh: 窗台这块颜色浅些，以前放过什么吧？
en: This patch on the sill is lighter. Something used to sit here?

zh: 这东西在屋里也用不上，先收着吧
en: No use for this in here. I'll keep it

zh: 这边近，咱从这儿走
en: This way's shorter. We'll go through here

zh: 这条路多久没人走了？
en: How long since anyone walked this road?

zh: 底下那几根你帮咱拖一下，挑轻的就行
en: Help me drag the ones underneath. Just the light ones

zh: 大的咱来顶。
en: I'll push the big one.

zh: 问起旧路，鹿忙着让我搬树枝，回头再问。
en: Asked about the old road. The deer got busy making me move branches. Ask again later.

zh: 这根太重了，先拖底下的树枝吧
en: Too heavy. I'll drag the branches underneath first

zh: 从底下走，树皮滑，摔了咱可接不住你
en: Go under. The bark's slippery. If you fall, I can't catch you

zh: 大象也从这儿走过？
en: Did the elephant come through here too?

zh: ……以前吧。
en: ...A while back, maybe.

zh: 这几根我来就行
en: I can handle these

zh: 拿得动吗？分两趟呗
en: Can you carry that? Make two trips

zh: 拿得动，你顾好你那边就行
en: I've got it. You worry about your end

zh: 走吧。
en: Let's go.

zh: 你见到大象的时候，离多近啊？
en: When you saw the elephant, how close were you?

zh: 隔得远，咱站的地方也不太好
en: Pretty far. And I wasn't standing in a good spot

zh: 鹿说：离得太远了。
en: The deer says: it was too far away.

zh: 这边走，水声最响那块底下是空的，咱掉下去过
en: This way. Where the water's loudest, the ground's hollow. I fell in once

zh: 右边有敲树的声音，应该是鹿吧
en: Something's knocking on a tree to the right. Must be the deer

zh: 蹄印。
en: Hoofprints.

zh: 鹿往前面去了
en: The deer went on ahead

zh: 看岔了，就是根树枝
en: My mistake. Just a branch

zh: 光秃秃的，布条呢？
en: Bare. Where's the cloth?

zh: 雾里跟错了一次。先听，再走。
en: Took a wrong turn in the fog once. Listen first, then walk.

zh: 蹄印往前去了，再照远一点看看
en: The hoofprints keep going. Let me light up further ahead

zh: 那根树枝上挂着布条。
en: There's a strip of cloth on that branch.

zh: 还是得找个能照亮的东西
en: I need something to light the way

zh: 等下，前面是空的
en: Wait. The ground drops away ahead

zh: 背包那块木板应该够长，搭上去试试
en: The plank in my bag should be long enough. Let's try it

zh: 这底下还有水，踩空就麻烦了
en: There's water down there. One wrong step and I'm in trouble

zh: 得找个东西搭过去才行
en: I need something to bridge it

zh: 拿这个搭桥够呛，再找找吧
en: That won't make a bridge. Keep looking

zh: 搭住了，慢点过应该行
en: It holds. Should be fine if I go slowly

zh: 找到布条了
en: Found the cloth

zh: 沿着布条这边走
en: Follow the cloth this way

zh: 你当时看清大象的样子了吗？
en: Did you get a good look at the elephant?

zh: 就一个背影，咱也没看清
en: Just its back. I couldn't really see

zh: 鹿说：只看到了背影。
en: The deer says: only saw it from behind.

zh: 鼻子都说得出来，怎么又只见过背影？
en: The deer knew about the nose, but only saw it from behind?

zh: 喂，你又跟谁吹自己见过大象了？
en: Hey. Who are you bragging to about the elephant this time?

zh: 隔着窗都听见你了，嗓门还挺大
en: I can hear you through the window. Loud, aren't you

zh: 咱这回是带人来修东西的
en: This time I brought someone with something to fix

zh: 请问……能修飞机吗？
en: Excuse me... can you fix a ship?

zh: 不能。
en: No.

zh: 喂，坏的零件呢，拿过来看看
en: Hey, where's the broken part? Let me see it

zh: 你站门口看着我干什么，零件拿来啊
en: Why are you just standing in the door? Bring the part

zh: 你往飞机里加的什么啊？
en: What did you put in this ship?

zh: 燃料。
en: Fuel.

zh: 谢谢啊，我还以为你给它喂了午饭呢
en: Thanks. I thought maybe you fed it lunch

zh: 我问你加的哪种燃料
en: I mean what kind of fuel

zh: 便宜的
en: The cheap kind

zh: 哈？就为了省这点钱，你敢开着这飞机飞那么远？
en: Huh? You flew this thing all that way to save a few coins?

zh: 真有你的。
en: You're something else.

zh: 卖的时候那人拍着胸口说能用，我就买了
en: The seller swore it was fine, so I bought it

zh: 那你让卖燃料的坐上来，带他飞一圈啊
en: Then put the seller in and take him for a spin

zh: 副驾驶不算，让他坐推进器上试试
en: Not the passenger seat. Strap him to the thruster

zh: 还笑呢，等飞机飞得起来再笑吧
en: Laughing? Save it for when it flies

zh: 过来啊，站那么远，怕我把你也拆了？
en: Come here. Why so far? Afraid I'll take you apart too?

zh: 架上这些都修好了吧，怎么没人来拿？
en: All this on the shelves is fixed, right? Why hasn't anyone picked it up?

zh: 东西的主人都搬走了
en: The owners all moved away

zh: 都搬走了？
en: All of them?

zh: 差不多。
en: More or less.

zh: 那这些东西你还一直留着？
en: And you've kept all of it?

zh: 都修好了，扔了多浪费，你倒舍得
en: It all works. Throwing it out would be a waste. You'd do that?

zh: 坐啊，哎那把放着，坐你面前这把！
en: Sit. No, not that one. The one in front of you!

zh: 喝点水？
en: Some water?

zh: 我不太爱甜的。
en: I don't really like sweet things.

zh: 那先放着呗，你要求还挺多
en: Then leave it. Picky, aren't you

zh: 喝这杯，没放糖，再挑你就渴着吧
en: Drink this one. No sugar. Complain again and you can stay thirsty

zh: 「别拿去装螺丝。」
en: "Not for screws."

zh: 杯底贴着纸条：别拿去装螺丝。旁边画了一个歪歪的生气脸。
en: A note stuck to the bottom of the cup: Not for screws. Next to it, a lopsided angry face.

zh: 杯子有什么好看的，你还走不走了？
en: What's so interesting about a cup? Are we doing this or not?

zh: 想飞起来还差三样东西，你听好啊
en: To fly, you still need three things. Listen up

zh: 松脂，拿来堵漏
en: Sap, to plug the leak

zh: 再找根弹簧，还有阀门零件，记住没？
en: Then a spring, and a valve part. Got that?

zh: 去哪里找？
en: Where do I find them?

zh: 问门口那只鹿呗，带路的事它最来劲
en: Ask the deer outside. Nothing it loves more than showing the way

zh: 这罐子拿好，装松脂用，别蹭得到处都是
en: Take this jar for the sap. Don't smear it everywhere

zh: 修推进器要三样东西：松脂、弹簧、阀门零件。
en: Three things to fix the thruster: sap, a spring, a valve part.

zh: 弥洛出去了啊，那晚点再来
en: Milo's out. I'll come back later

zh: 三样找齐再来，少一样都修不了
en: Come back with all three. One short and I can't fix it

zh: 罐子拿稳啊，洒了你自己洗
en: Hold that jar steady. Spill it, you clean it

zh: 那几件修好的东西，你送回去了？
en: Those things I fixed. You took them back?

zh: 嗯
en: Mm

zh: 找东西啊，这你问咱就对了
en: Looking for something? You asked the right deer

zh: 商店旁边那棵老松你瞧见没，松脂一直往外冒
en: See the old pine by the shop? Sap keeps oozing out of it

zh: 空屋窗台有个闹钟，停了好些年了
en: There's a clock on the empty house's sill. Stopped years ago

zh: 舍不得拆闹钟，就去空地那个信号箱看看
en: If you'd rather not take the clock apart, try the signal box in the clearing

zh: 塌陷口那头有个旧信号箱，去那儿找
en: There's an old signal box past the sinkhole. Look there

zh: 塌陷口得先搭块板子，可别一脚踩下去
en: You'll need a board across the sinkhole. Don't step in it

zh: 商店货架都烂了，能拆块木板下来
en: The shop shelves are rotten. You could pull a plank off

zh: 零件齐了就进去吧，咱可帮不上修东西的忙
en: Got everything? Go on in. I'm no help with fixing

zh: 松脂、弹簧、阀门，齐了，回树屋吧
en: Sap, spring, valve. That's everything. Back to the treehouse

zh: 这块木板还挺结实，带上吧
en: This plank's pretty solid. I'll take it

zh: 松脂从这道口子里渗出来了
en: Sap's seeping out of this cut

zh: 接着点，别都滴地上了
en: Better catch it before it all drips away

zh: 得拿罐子来接
en: I need a jar to catch it

zh: 装满了，拿稳点，可别洒一身
en: Full. Steady now, don't get it all over me

zh: 松脂还在往外渗
en: Sap's still seeping out

zh: 这闹钟停了多久了，指针都不动了
en: How long has this clock been stopped? The hands don't move at all

zh: 闹钟里应该有能用的弹簧吧
en: There should be a usable spring in there

zh: 可人家回来，还得用这个吧
en: But they'll need it when they come back

zh: 留张字条，借走弹簧
en: Leave a note, borrow the spring

zh: 先不拿，找找别的
en: Leave it, look elsewhere

zh: 「借走一根弹簧。晨。」
en: "Borrowed one spring. Chen."

zh: 空屋窗台的闹钟里借了一根弹簧，留了字条。
en: Borrowed a spring from the clock on the empty house's sill. Left a note.

zh: 先找找别的吧，也不急着拆人家闹钟
en: I'll look elsewhere first. No rush to take apart someone's clock

zh: 字条还压在闹钟底下
en: My note's still under the clock

zh: 闹钟还停着
en: The clock's still stopped

zh: 信号箱都废在这儿了
en: This signal box has been dead a long time

zh: 阀门还拧得动，可以拿下来
en: The valve still turns. I can take it off

zh: 旁边还有一根备用的弹簧
en: There's a spare spring next to it

zh: 信号箱里能用的都拿出来了
en: I've taken everything useful from the signal box

zh: 收音机上也有牌子，是谁送来修的啊？
en: The radio has a tag too. Who brought it in?

zh: 早修好了，在这儿放到现在也没人来听
en: Fixed it ages ago. It's sat here ever since, and no one's come to listen

zh: 我们那边的广播啊，来来回回就报那几个站名
en: The radio back home just read the same few station names, over and over

zh: 牌子上写着：小吃棚。
en: The tag says: Snack Stall.

zh: 带去还给主人
en: Take it back to its owner

zh: 先放着
en: Leave it for now

zh: 小吃棚顺路，我把收音机带回去？
en: The snack stall's on my way. Should I take the radio back?

zh: 拿吧，底下托着点，才修好的
en: Go ahead. Hold it from the bottom. I just fixed it

zh: 这路标怎么还自己转？
en: Why does this signpost spin by itself?

zh: 路标嘛，还没找着方向呢
en: It's a signpost. It hasn't found its way yet

zh: 让它转呗，你别伸手掰就行
en: Let it spin. Just don't grab it

zh: 底下的牌子写着：空地。
en: The tag underneath says: Clearing.

zh: 路标我也带过去，放回空地那边？
en: I'll take the signpost too. Back to the clearing?

zh: 随你，哎你拿那头干什么，尖的，扎手
en: Suit yourself. Hey, not that end. It's pointy

zh: 这盏油灯也修好了？
en: This oil lamp's fixed too?

zh: 灯芯换好了，就是没油了，想点得自己找
en: New wick. No oil, though. Want it lit, find your own

zh: 牌子上写着：路边的小屋
en: The tag says: Roadside Hut

zh: 这盏灯我放回路边小屋的窗台上吧？
en: Should I put this lamp back on the roadside hut's sill?

zh: 行，走路看着点，灯罩薄，磕一下就碎了
en: Fine. Watch your step. The glass is thin. One bump and it's gone

zh: 收音机怎么全是沙沙声啊
en: Nothing but static

zh: 雨棚下面压着一张纸条
en: There's a note tucked under the awning

zh: 「收摊了。往云那边走。」
en: "Closed up. Heading for the clouds."

zh: 纸条这半边泡花了，字都认不出来
en: The rain's smeared this half. I can't read it

zh: 小吃棚的雨棚下压着一张纸条：收摊了，往云那边走。
en: A note under the snack stall's awning: Closed up. Heading for the clouds.

zh: 油灯先摆回窗台吧，油以后再添
en: Lamp back on the sill. Oil can come later

zh: 门框上这些线，是用来量身高的吧？
en: These lines on the doorframe... for measuring height?

zh: 最高这道边上，还刻了朵小云
en: There's a little cloud carved by the highest one

zh: 路边小屋的门框上刻着身高线。最后一道旁边，刻着一朵云。
en: Height marks on the roadside hut's doorframe. Next to the last one, a carved cloud.

zh: 路标停了啊
en: The signpost stopped

zh: 指的是云那边
en: It's pointing at the clouds

zh: 底座旁边，压着半张车票
en: Half a ticket, tucked by the base

zh: 车票终点都泡花了，这可怎么找
en: The destination's washed out. No way to know where they went

zh: 路标归位，朝着云那边。底座旁有半张车票，终点泡花了。
en: Signpost back in place, facing the clouds. Half a ticket by the base, the destination washed out.

zh: 收音机还是沙沙响
en: Still static

zh: 这朵云刻得浅，差点漏看
en: The cloud's carved so faintly I almost missed it

zh: 这底座空着呢
en: The base is empty

zh: 该放什么上来呢？
en: What goes up here?

zh: 底座塞不下这个，换一个试试
en: That won't fit. Try something else

zh: 路标还指着云那边
en: The signpost still points at the clouds

zh: 这上面刻的是……
en: Something's carved here...

zh: 长鼻子，四条腿
en: A long nose. Four legs

zh: 像是小孩刻的
en: Looks like a kid did it

zh: 刻痕都磨平了，应该有些年头了吧
en: The lines are worn smooth. It must be old

zh: 很久以前，就有人见过它
en: Someone saw it, long ago

zh: 画得跟小孩画的一样，也许谁都没见过
en: Drawn like a kid's picture. Maybe no one ever saw it

zh: 岩石上刻着长鼻子、四条腿，看着挺旧的
en: A long nose and four legs carved in rock. Looks old

zh: 很久以前，就有人见过它。
en: Someone saw it, long ago.

zh: 刻这幅画的人，当时也站在这儿吧
en: Whoever carved this must have stood right here

zh: 工具的轮廓描了两排，怎么差这么高？
en: Two rows of tool outlines. Why so far apart?

zh: 下面那排工具都拿走了啊
en: The bottom row's all gone

zh: 「用完放回来，我够不到」
en: "Put them back when you're done. I can't reach"

zh: 「那就长高一点」
en: "Then grow a little"

zh: 刚才弥洛不让我坐的，就是这把吧
en: This must be the chair Milo wouldn't let me sit in

zh: 外套褪色褪成这样，还搭在椅背上呢
en: The coat's this faded, and it's still draped over the back

zh: 椅子倒是擦得很干净
en: The chair's spotless, though

zh: 外套还搭在那儿
en: The coat's still there

zh: 「别拿去装螺丝」
en: "Not for screws"

zh: 这张生气脸，画得还挺像
en: The angry face is a pretty good likeness

zh: 这包新零件拆开过了吧
en: This new part's been unwrapped before

zh: 包装纸都折软了，又给包回去了
en: The paper's gone soft from folding. Wrapped back up again

zh: 旧零件补了这么多回，还接着用啊
en: The old part's been patched so many times, and it's still in use

zh: 玻璃下面压着半张明信片
en: Half a postcard, pressed under the glass

zh: 邮戳是河流城市的
en: Postmarked from the river city

zh: 树脂就放一小块，试试嘛
en: Just a little resin. Let's see

zh: 喂，你怎么往我炉子里乱塞东西！
en: Hey! Don't just shove things in my stove!

zh: 算了，还挺香的，就这一块啊
en: Fine. It smells nice. Just the one

zh: 这东西收好吧，放炉子里该烧坏了
en: Better keep this. It'd burn up in there

zh: 收音机的名牌都落灰了，字盖住一半
en: The radio's name tag is dusty. Half the writing's covered

zh: 放那儿吧，我待会儿擦
en: Leave it. I'll wipe it later

zh: 路标还在转呢
en: The signpost's still spinning

zh: 让它转呗，又没挡你的路
en: Let it spin. It's not in your way

zh: 碟子里全是螺丝
en: The dish is full of screws

zh: 这些螺丝我挑过了，都能用，你别给我丢了
en: I sorted those. They all work. Don't lose any

zh: 水是温的
en: The water's warm

zh: ……糖罐别动
en: ...Leave the sugar alone

zh: 以前早上赶车，哪有空等水烧开啊
en: Back when I rushed for the train every morning, who had time to wait for a kettle

zh: 架子上还是摆着两个杯子
en: Still two cups on the shelf

zh: 杯子顺手拿的，你还数上了？
en: I just grabbed some cups. You're counting now?

zh: 一台留声机
en: A gramophone

zh: 留声机先别碰，放着放着就卡了
en: Don't touch that. It sticks partway through

zh: 这曲子总算放完了
en: It finally played all the way through

zh: 这曲子怎么这么慢啊
en: Why is this song so slow

zh: 桌上有个盒子
en: There's a box on the table

zh: 盒子放着吧，你要的东西不在里面
en: Leave the box. What you need isn't in there

zh: 盒子空了
en: The box is empty

zh: 盒子看够了？把盖子合上吧
en: Seen enough? Close the lid

zh: 墙上的管道一直在响
en: The pipes in the wall keep making noise

zh: 管道响我听见了，先修你那飞机，急什么
en: I hear them. Your ship first. What's the hurry

zh: 这段管道是我拧的
en: I tightened this one

zh: 拧反了两次，你还挺得意
en: Turned it the wrong way twice, and look how proud you are

zh: 还不走？门在左边
en: Still here? The door's on the left

zh: 燃料买好点的啊，省那点钱干什么
en: Buy better fuel. Why scrimp on that

zh: 还挺快嘛，零件摊开，我看看
en: That was quick. Lay the parts out, let me see

zh: 我也帮点忙吧，总不能光坐着看
en: Let me help. I can't just sit and watch

zh: 不用
en: No need

zh: 左边第二把，递过来
en: Second from the left. Hand it over

zh: 左边第一把
en: First from the left

zh: 左边第二把
en: Second from the left

zh: 最大的那把
en: The biggest one

zh: 这才第一把，要我帮你数啊？
en: That's the first one. Want me to count for you?

zh: 拿错了！那么大一把，你看能伸进去吗？
en: Wrong one! That huge thing? Think it'll fit in there?

zh: 先松开这里，再——
en: First loosen this, then...

zh: 这个我知道
en: I know this part

zh: 知道了？
en: You know?

zh: 刚才谁说自己知道的？
en: So much for "I know this"

zh: 我就看过说明书，图上画得挺简单的啊
en: I read the manual. The pictures made it look easy

zh: 那就看我这边，窗户上又没写说明书
en: Then look over here. The manual's not on the window

zh: 不会你就问，弄坏了我真要骂你了啊
en: If you don't know, ask. Break it and I really will yell at you

zh: 听
en: Listen

zh: 你闭着眼也听得出来啊？
en: You can tell with your eyes closed?

zh: 你先睁着眼行不行，手都拧反了
en: How about you keep yours open? You're turning it backwards

zh: 左边那段
en: Left pipe

zh: 中间那段
en: Middle pipe

zh: 右边那段
en: Right pipe

zh: 这段听着挺脆，像敲空瓶子
en: This one sounds crisp. Like tapping an empty bottle

zh: 这段没事
en: That one's fine

zh: 闷闷的，像隔着一层被子
en: Muffled. Like through a blanket

zh: 这段就是积灰了，接着听下一段
en: That one's just dusty. Try the next

zh: 这儿有点尖响，应该就是这段了吧？
en: A thin, sharp hiss. This must be the one?

zh: 这回对了吧？
en: Got it this time, right?

zh: 总算听出来了
en: Finally

zh: 再听错我真要怀疑你耳朵了
en: One more wrong guess and I'd start worrying about your ears

zh: 右边那段管道，细小的尖响。
en: Right pipe: a thin, sharp hiss.

zh: 这次没猜
en: Didn't guess this time

zh: 还挺结实
en: Feels solid

zh: 那当然，我在旁边盯了你多久啊
en: Of course. I watched you the whole time

zh: 谢谢
en: Thanks

zh: 知道了，下回我教你的时候，你先让我说完
en: Yeah, yeah. Next time I'm teaching you, let me finish first

zh: 装回飞机的时候，照着刚才的顺序来。
en: When you put it back in the ship, do it in the same order.

zh: 管道装好了。右边那段漏气，听着有细细的尖声。
en: Pipes done. The right one was leaking. You could hear a thin hiss.

zh: 我的音乐盒也老卡在一半
en: My music box always gets stuck halfway too

zh: 你的音乐盒啊，下次少拍两下吧
en: Your music box. Hit it less next time

zh: 它都卡住了，你拍它也唱不出来啊
en: It's stuck. Smacking it won't make it sing

zh: 这留声机怎么还卡着？
en: Why is the gramophone still stuck?

zh: 零件不合适
en: Wrong part

zh: 那这个新零件呢？
en: What about this new part?

zh: 能用
en: It works

zh: 那为什么不换？
en: Then why not swap it in?

zh: 换上新的，声音就不一样了
en: With a new one, it won't sound the same

zh: 我还以为能响了就算修好了
en: I thought if it made sound, it was fixed

zh: 那就先放着吧
en: Then leave it for now

zh: 我的音乐盒，谢谢你
en: Thank you. For my music box

zh: 会响就算修好？你飞机摔下来的时候也挺响啊
en: If it makes sound, it's fixed? Your ship made plenty of sound coming down

zh: 我想什么时候修就什么时候修呗
en: I'll fix it whenever I feel like it

zh: 顺手修的，你拿好就行
en: It was nothing. Just hold on to it

zh: 拿稳你的音乐盒啊，再摔坏我可不管了
en: Hold on to that music box. Break it again and you're on your own

zh: 起来吧，还得出去送趟水泵
en: Up you get. We've got a water pump to deliver

zh: 水泵你抱着，拿稳啊
en: You carry the pump. Don't drop it

zh: 瞧，咱就说她修得好
en: See? I told you she could fix it

zh: 少来，每次给我领一堆麻烦回来，你都这么说
en: Please. You say that every time you bring me trouble

zh: 这屋上回咱来就空着了
en: This place was empty last time I came too

zh: 我知道啊，你都说几遍了
en: I know. You've said so a hundred times

zh: 窗台上的字条，你写的？
en: The note on the windowsill. Yours?

zh: 字条留着吧，人家回来总得知道谁拿的
en: Leave it there. When they're back, they'll want to know who took it

zh: 门槛上积了这么厚的灰
en: So much dust on the doorstep

zh: 连个脚印都找不着
en: Not a single footprint

zh: 门边这个包裹，放多久了？
en: How long has this parcel been by the door?

zh: 包装纸褪了色
en: The wrapping's faded

zh: 包裹这绳结倒挺紧，像最近重新系过
en: But the knot's tight. Like someone retied it recently

zh: 这门口一下雨就积水，咱绕着走
en: This doorway floods when it rains. I go around

zh: 后头有条近路
en: There's a shortcut out back

zh: 一直看着我干什么？
en: What are you staring at?

zh: 走啦，再看天都要黑了
en: Let's go. Keep looking and it'll be dark

zh: 你在看什么？
en: What are you looking at?

zh: 这家的饼甜得要命，我吃一次就够了
en: Their cakes are sickly sweet. Once was enough

zh: 咱记得你以前天天来
en: I remember you used to come every day

zh: 你连我吃几回饼都记着啊？
en: You keep count of how many cakes I eat?

zh: 弥洛以前跟她那朋友来，每回都——
en: Milo used to come with her friend, and every time...

zh: 有空看我，你先把角上那块破布摘了吧
en: If you've got time to watch me, take that rag off your antlers

zh: 我先回去了
en: I'm heading back

zh: 这块泥滑，咱摔过，脚下当心点
en: This mud's slippery. I fell here once. Watch your step

zh: 那家养过只鸟，见着咱就啄
en: That house had a bird. It pecked me every time

zh: 咱绕后头走吧，还近点
en: Let's go round the back. It's shorter

zh: 鹿说：那块泥容易打滑；那户人家养过很凶的鸟；从后头绕更快。
en: The deer says: the mud there is slippery; that house had a mean bird; round the back is faster.

zh: 总叫你鹿，日记上也这么写吗？
en: I keep calling you Deer. Is that what I write in my journal too?

zh: 就叫咱鹿呗，这里又没第二个
en: Just call me Deer. There's no other one here

zh: 页角那只大角鹿旁边，补上名字：鹿。
en: Added a name next to the big-antlered deer in the corner: Deer.

zh: 角还能画大点，咱的哪有这么小
en: You can draw the antlers bigger. Mine aren't that small

zh: 玻璃后面有一只空点心罐
en: An empty cookie jar behind the glass

zh: 「少糖的留两块」
en: "Save two of the less-sweet ones"

zh: 「她说难吃也要留」
en: "She says they're awful, but save them anyway"

zh: 里面的货架都塌了
en: The shelves inside have collapsed

zh: 这合影只剩半张，雨都泡皱了
en: Only half the photo's left, and the rain's wrinkled it

zh: 照片里那只手在给弥洛扣纸帽啊
en: The hand in the photo is putting a paper hat on Milo

zh: 鹿在坡上等你
en: The deer's waiting for you on the slope

zh: 看完回来一趟啊，还有东西给你
en: Come back after. I've got something for you

zh: 你当时是在这儿哪个位置看见大象的？
en: So where were you standing when you saw the elephant?

zh: 有个事，咱得跟你说
en: There's something I have to tell you

zh: 大象，咱其实没亲眼见过
en: I never actually saw the elephant

zh: 小时候，咱娘带咱走过这儿
en: When I was little, my ma brought me through here

zh: 咱娘指着雾里，说那边有大象
en: Ma pointed into the fog and said there was an elephant out there

zh: 咱个子矮，看不清，就记得咱娘站了好久
en: I was too short to see. I just remember Ma standing there a long time

zh: 后来咱娘不在了
en: Then Ma was gone

zh: 往后带人，咱还是走这条路
en: After that, whenever I showed someone the way, I still came this way

zh: 说得多了，就说成是咱亲眼见过了
en: I told it so many times, it turned into me seeing it myself

zh: 鼻子很长，左边的耳朵会动，走过去的时候树枝都在晃
en: Long nose. Left ear moves. The branches sway when it walks past

zh: 这些也是你编的？
en: You made all that up too?

zh: 有些是听来的，有些咱也记混了
en: Some of it I heard. Some I got mixed up

zh: 你知道我为了来这里——
en: Do you know what it took for me to get here...

zh: 咱怕说没见过，你就不肯跟咱来了
en: I was scared if I said I hadn't seen it, you wouldn't come with me

zh: 我得顺着你说，你才肯听，对吗？
en: So I have to tell you what you want to hear, or you won't listen. Right?

zh: 你可以带错路，但别骗我
en: You can get the way wrong. Just don't lie to me

zh: 我刚才真的很高兴
en: I was really happy, back there

zh: 以后不知道，就说不知道
en: Next time you don't know, just say so

zh: 路咱认得，大象的事是咱瞎说了
en: The way, I know. The elephant part, I made up

zh: 咱看见了，你连日记都拿出来了
en: I saw. You even got your journal out

zh: 该早点告诉你的，是咱嘴硬
en: I should've told you sooner. I was being stubborn

zh: 嗯，咱这回记住了
en: Mm. I'll remember this time

zh: 凹陷：最靠近坡边的那处被雨冲过，另外几处能看出连续的落点。
en: Hollows: the one nearest the edge is washed out by rain. The others look like a trail of footfalls.

zh: 哪一处最近？
en: Which one's newest?

zh: 就这块凹下去的，咱前几天来还没这么深
en: This one here. It wasn't this deep a few days ago

zh: 刚才那声，咱也听见了
en: I heard that too

zh: 还不知道是什么
en: Don't know what it is yet

zh: 低鸣从坡地东边的雾里来，只响了一声。
en: The low rumble came from the fog east of the slope. Just once.

zh: 最近那处又量了一次：长四步，宽三步半。
en: Measured the newest one again: four steps long, three and a half wide.

zh: 这些凹坑的样子都画下来了
en: I've drawn all these hollows

zh: 先记着吧，以后有线索了还能翻出来对对
en: I'll keep them. If something turns up, I can check back

zh: 这雾还这么厚
en: The fog's still so thick

zh: 再往那头就看不清了
en: Can't see anything past here

zh: 大象的事，我想自己再找找看
en: The elephant... I want to keep looking on my own

zh: 回去吧，弥洛该等急了
en: Let's go back. Milo'll be getting impatient

zh: 她要嫌咱慢，你听听就行
en: If she grumbles that we're slow, just let it go

zh: 留声机那个旧零件，实在用不了了
en: That old part in the gramophone. It was past using

zh: 看什么，坏成那样，本来就该换了
en: What? It was that broken. It needed replacing anyway

zh: 这首曲子慢死了
en: This song is painfully slow

zh: 以前不是这个速度吗？
en: Wasn't it always this speed?

zh: 我那朋友嫌慢，非得自己调快
en: My friend thought it was too slow. Insisted on speeding it up

zh: 调坏了还不认，说是我听不懂
en: Broke it, wouldn't admit it. Said I just didn't get it

zh: 笑什么，你又没听过她唱
en: What's funny? You never heard her sing

zh: 她一唱起来，比留声机还快
en: When she sang, she was faster than the gramophone

zh: 你那朋友后来去哪儿了？
en: Where did your friend go?

zh: 不知道
en: No idea

zh: 只知道去过河流城市
en: Only that she went through the river city

zh: 再往后，我就没消息了
en: After that, I heard nothing

zh: 她走之前应该跟你说过吧？
en: She must have told you before she left

zh: 说了
en: She did

zh: 那你……
en: Then you...

zh: 那会儿正吵架呢，我哪听得进去啊
en: We were in the middle of a fight. I wasn't listening

zh: 她收东西，我就说想走就走呗
en: She was packing, and I said, go if you want

zh: 都到门口了还磨蹭，我又说了一遍
en: She dawdled at the door, so I said it again

zh: 我就是气不过啊
en: I was just so angry

zh: 这儿好好的东西还多着呢
en: There's plenty of good stuff right here

zh: 她说走就走，倒像是我非赖在这儿一样
en: She just up and left. Like I was the one clinging to this place

zh: 以前迟到十分钟都得跟我解释半天
en: She used to explain for ages if she was ten minutes late

zh: 这回可省事了，连借口都懒得找
en: This time she made it easy. Didn't even bother with an excuse

zh: 那个人的号码，你还留着吗？
en: Do you still have her number?

zh: 发送失败　发送失败　发送失败
en: Failed to send  Failed to send  Failed to send

zh: 换过号码了。
en: She changed numbers.

zh: 她走的时候说，安顿下来再给我新的。
en: When she left, she said she'd send the new one once she was settled.

zh: 要是哪天真收到她的消息呢？
en: What if you hear from her someday?

zh: 收到再说呗，谁知道到时候还想不想回。
en: I'll worry about it then. Who knows if I'll even want to reply.

zh: 你要去河流城市吧，把这包种子带上
en: You're going to the river city, right? Take this seed with you

zh: 要我替你种在哪儿？
en: Where do you want me to plant it?

zh: 你想种就种呗
en: Plant it wherever you like

zh: 别埋太深啊，先浇一点水
en: Don't bury it too deep. Water it a little first

zh: 还有，别隔两天就挖出来看看长没长
en: And don't dig it up every other day to check

zh: 等种子自己冒头呗，你盯着也长不快啊
en: Let it come up on its own. Staring won't make it grow faster

zh: 你以前也挖出来看过吧？
en: You used to dig yours up to check, didn't you?

zh: 你管我！教你种东西呢，你就听见这句？
en: Mind your own business! I'm teaching you to plant, and that's what you heard?

zh: 好，我记着，省得回头真种坏了
en: Okay, I'll write it down. So I don't kill it

zh: 种子：别埋太深，先浇一点水。不许隔两天就挖出来看。
en: Seed: not too deep, water it a little first. No digging it up every other day to check.

zh: 这也记啊，你本子够写吗？
en: You're writing that down too? Got enough pages?

zh: 河流城市的地址，能抄一份吗？
en: Can I copy down the address in the river city?

zh: 地址上的字是潦草了点，不认识就问我
en: The handwriting's messy. Ask if you can't read it

zh: 别抄错了又来怪我啊
en: And don't copy it wrong and blame me

zh: 那三件东西，你全送回原来的地方了？
en: Those three things. You took them all back?

zh: 嗯，路标放回去就不转了，指着云那边
en: Yeah. Once the signpost was back, it stopped spinning. It points at the clouds

zh: 我知道路标指哪边，修的时候就知道了
en: I know where it points. Knew it when I fixed it

zh: 听鹿说，你去还东西了？
en: The deer says you've been returning things?

zh: ……多事
en: ...Busybody

zh: 种子长出来，我就回来告诉你
en: When the seed sprouts, I'll come back and tell you

zh: 说好了啊，别随便拔棵草回来就说是种出来的
en: Deal. But don't pull up some weed and tell me you grew it

zh: 我给的种子长什么样，我认得
en: I know what my seed grows into

zh: 不会
en: I won't

zh: 还有，下次来先敲门啊
en: And next time, knock first

zh: 也就我肯帮你收拾这些了
en: Nobody else would clean up after you like this

zh: 砸倒一片树林，还得给你修飞机
en: You flatten half a forest, and I still fix your ship

zh: 谢谢你
en: Thank you

zh: 没长出来也可以回来啊，又没说一定得长出来
en: You can come back even if it doesn't sprout. Nobody said it had to

zh: 等等。通讯器拿来。
en: Wait. Give me your communicator.

zh: 接头再响就发这里。
en: If the joint starts making noise again, message here.

zh: 把哪边响、什么时候响写清楚，别一上来就喊救命。
en: Say which side and when. Don't just open with "help."

zh: 弥洛·修理
en: Milo · Repairs

zh: 修理。省得你把它当许愿箱。
en: Repairs. So you don't treat it like a wishing well.

zh: 也给咱留个位置，咱有事就来这儿找她发。
en: Save a spot for me too. If I need something, I'll come get her to send it.

zh: 你先把蹄子擦干净再进来。
en: Wipe your hooves before you come in.

zh: 改正：长鼻子、左耳会动、树枝晃，都是鹿听来的。
en: Correction: the long nose, the moving left ear, the swaying branches. The deer only heard about them.

zh: 我能找到大象吗？
en: Will I find the elephant?

zh: 这咱不知道，咱就认得森林里这几条路
en: That I don't know. I only know the paths in this forest

zh: 下次你再来，旧路可能又变样了
en: Next time you come, the old road might look different again

zh: 到路口喊咱就行，咱带你走
en: Just call for me at the turnoff. I'll take you

zh: 好，这回我也记着点路
en: Okay. This time I'll remember the way too

zh: 旧路路口：下次先到这儿找鹿。
en: Turnoff to the old road: next time, find the deer here first.

zh: 路上小心
en: Be careful out there

zh: 云底下咱没去过，你自己当心点啊
en: I've never been under the clouds. Take care of yourself

zh: 那等我回来，讲给你听
en: Then I'll tell you about it when I'm back

zh: 云底下到底什么样，还是得自己去看看
en: Whatever's under the clouds, I'll have to see for myself

zh: 走了
en: I'm off

zh: 小吃棚的雨棚底下压着张字条，说收摊了，往云那边走。
en: There was a note under the snack stall's awning. It said they'd closed up and headed for the clouds.

zh: 小屋门框上有量身高的线，最高那道旁边刻了朵云。
en: The hut's doorframe has height marks. There's a cloud carved by the highest one.

zh: 路标放回底座就停了，指着云那边。旁边压着半张车票。
en: Once the signpost was on its base, it stopped. It points at the clouds. There was half a ticket beside it.

zh: 送回去了就行，看我干什么
en: You took them back. That's enough. Why are you looking at me
